label: Weather & Device Retention
info: Guarded weather archive/raw retention and DeviceMonitoring pruning. Runs maintain_weather_device_retention() daily at 03:20 America/Denver and alerts if a complete successful run is more than 36 hours old.

nodes.name: Retention succeeded
Check complete retention health
nodes.template:
SELECT
    LastArchiveSuccessUTC,
    LastValidationUTC,
    LastWeatherPruneSuccessUTC,
    LastDevicePruneSuccessUTC,
    LastFullSuccessUTC,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LastFullSuccessUTC, UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS FullSuccessAgeHours,
    PruningEnabled,
    ReadyToPrune,
    LastNote
FROM v_weather_retention_readiness
WHERE Id=1;

Guarded 14d weather archive + 90d device retention
nodes.info: Daily maintenance archives complete weather hours, validates sample count/min/max/average and source boundaries, then deletes weather in whole-hour units so validation remains resumable. DeviceMonitoring is pruned in bounded timestamp batches. A named DB lock prevents concurrent runs, audit rows record every stage, and SQL failures trigger Pushover.
